principles: Decide what each payday is for before it arrives: essentials, savings, then the rest.
Put savings aside first; spend what is left.
Check the month ahead for bills that land before the next payday.

gentle.title: Plan the month on payday
gentle.body: With savings of {savings_balance}, a late payday or an unexpected bill could leave you short. Spend a few minutes on payday setting aside what your essentials need, around {essential_monthly_spend} a month, before the rest.

blunt.title: Plan every payday
blunt.body: Your savings of {savings_balance} will not last a month of essentials, which run to {essential_monthly_spend}. On payday, cover the essentials first, put something aside and spend only what remains.
